scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run start --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
